games.title: Pressure Grid
games.blurb: Pump pressure into cells, siphon it toward neighbors, and ride the chain reactions when cells erupt.

mechanics.name: pump
mechanics.description: Tap a cell to add pressure to it.

mechanics.name: siphon
mechanics.description: Drag from a cell to move a fraction of its pressure into the neighbor you dragged toward, losing some to inefficiency.

games.sharedState: Pressure per cell: written by pump and siphon, read by siphon and by the passive bleed-and-eruption system.
games.goal: Sandbox, with no win condition. Chase the achievements.
games.howToPlay: Pressure builds wherever you pump it and constantly bleeds into neighboring cells. When a cell reaches the limit it erupts (flashes white), empties, and blasts pressure into its neighbors, which can set off chain reactions. Siphoning lets you move pressure around before that happens, or aim an eruption where you want it.

achievements.title: Chain Reaction
achievements.description: Set off 5 or more eruptions at once.

achievements.title: Siphon Strike
achievements.description: Cause an eruption with a siphon.

achievements.title: Full Pressure
achievements.description: Get every cell on the board to 20+ pressure at once.

games.title: Orbit Garden
games.blurb: Place planets, fling seeds around them, and grow a garden in orbit. Every seed that lands makes its planet pull harder.
games.goal: Get 3 planets blooming at the same time before your 40 seeds run out.
games.howToPlay: Seeds launch from the launcher at the bottom and bend around every planet on their way up. Each seed that lands makes its planet heavier, and heavier planets pull harder, so a big planet can start stealing seeds meant for its neighbors. Planets you don't feed slowly wither away. Drag upward to fling; a short dotted line previews the start of the path.

mechanics.name: place
mechanics.description: Tap the sky to add a small planet (a gravity well).

mechanics.name: fling
mechanics.description: Drag upward to launch a seed from the launcher; it curves around planets and adds mass to the one it lands on.

games.sharedState: Planet mass: placing creates it, landed seeds add to it, and it sets how hard each planet pulls on every seed. A passive wither drains it, and blooming is read from it.

achievements.title: First Bloom
achievements.description: Grow a planet until it blooms.

achievements.title: Frugal Gardener
achievements.description: Complete a garden with 15 or more seeds left.

achievements.title: Gravity Assist
achievements.description: Land a seed that swung more than 90° away from where you flung it.

achievements.title: Green Thumb
achievements.description: Land 5 seeds in a row without a miss.

achievements.title: Full Sky
achievements.description: Have 5 planets in the sky at once.

games.title: Murmuration
games.blurb: Lure a flock of starlings through a string of gates. Startle them to steer, but panic spreads from bird to bird.
games.goal: Fly 15 birds through each of the 5 gates, in order and close together, before the flock drops below 15 birds.
games.howToPlay: The flock steers itself: birds stay close to their neighbors and match their heading. Hold anywhere and calm birds fly toward your finger; keep holding and move it to lead them. Tap to startle the birds near the tap: they panic (turning red) and burst away from it, which can shove the flock through a gate. A gate only counts birds that flew through it in the last few seconds, so bring the flock through together. Fear spreads to neighbors and fades over time. Scared birds ignore your lure, birds packed too tightly get scared on their own, and panicked birds can fly off the edge of the sky and be lost.

mechanics.name: lure
mechanics.description: Press and hold to draw calm birds toward your finger. Move while holding to lead them.

mechanics.name: startle
mechanics.description: Tap to scare the birds nearby, sending them bursting away from the tap.

games.sharedState: Each bird's fear: startling raises it, it spreads from bird to bird, and crowding around the lure raises it. The lure's pull fades as fear rises, and panicked birds stop avoiding the edges of the sky.

achievements.title: Takeoff
achievements.description: Fly the flock through the first gate.

achievements.title: No Bird Left Behind
achievements.description: Clear all 5 gates without losing a single bird.

achievements.title: Chain Panic
achievements.description: Startle once and watch the panic spread to 15 birds the tap never touched.

achievements.title: Soft Touch
achievements.description: Clear all 5 gates with 3 or fewer startles.

achievements.title: Swift
achievements.description: Clear all 5 gates in under 90 seconds.
